title: Every commit on a feature branch catches up with origin/main when the merge is clean (post-commit branch sync)
goal: Agents sync with remote main after every feature they commit, not only at claim and push: .githooks/sync-branch, called by post-commit, fetches origin and merges origin/main into the branch when that merge applies cleanly, and aborts and tells the agent to merge now when it conflicts. Never in the primary checkout, on main, mid-merge, in a dirty tree or inside workflow finish. Conflicts stay one commit small and sync-before-push is already satisfied at push time.
